l0.text: All shipments of custom wiring harnesses under this Agreement shall be packaged in accordance with Supplier's standard export packaging specifications, or such other specifications as the parties may agree in writing, and shall be accompanied by a packing list identifying the purchase order number, quantity, and batch or lot identifier. Supplier shall provide Buyer with advance shipping notification not less than 14 days prior to the scheduled ship date. Buyer shall inspect each shipment within ninety (90) days of receipt and shall notify Supplier in writing of any discrepancy in quantity or apparent damage, failing which the shipment shall be deemed accepted as delivered. Supplier shall retain records of each shipment's packing list and carrier manifest for a period of not less than ninety (90) days, and shall make such records available to Buyer upon reasonable written request for the purpose of resolving any delivery dispute. Title to rejected goods shall remain with Supplier pending disposition instructions from Supplier, which shall be provided within 14 days of receiving notice of rejection.

Supplier represents and warrants that all industrial control modules supplied hereunder shall be new, of merchantable quality, and fit for the purpose for which such goods are customarily used, and shall comply in all material respects with the applicable specifications for a period of no less than sixty (60) days following delivery. Supplier shall, at its own expense, correct any nonconformity identified during the warranty period within 45 days of receiving written notice from Buyer describing the nonconformity in reasonable detail, provided that such correction is commercially and technically feasible. If Supplier is unable to correct the nonconformity within the 45-day period, Buyer may procure replacement goods from a third party and recover the reasonable additional cost of doing so from Supplier, provided Buyer has given Supplier a reasonable opportunity to cure. Nothing in this Clause shall limit any statutory warranty that cannot lawfully be excluded in the State of New York.

Buyer shall pay all undisputed invoices within sixty (60) days of the invoice date, by wire transfer to the bank account designated by Supplier in writing. Invoices not disputed in writing within 5 days of receipt shall be deemed accepted. Amounts not paid when due shall accrue interest at the rate of one and one-half percent (1.5%) per month, or the maximum rate permitted by applicable law, whichever is lower. All amounts payable under this Agreement are exclusive of applicable value-added, sales, or similar taxes, which shall be borne by Buyer unless otherwise required by law. Buyer may withhold payment of any invoiced amount that is subject to a good-faith dispute, provided Buyer notifies Supplier in writing of the basis for the dispute within 5 days of receipt of the invoice, and the parties shall use reasonable efforts to resolve the dispute within sixty (60) days. Neither party shall be entitled to set off amounts owed under this Agreement against amounts owed under any other agreement between the parties absent written agreement to the contrary.

Each party shall treat as confidential all technical, commercial, and financial information disclosed by the other party in connection with this Agreement, and shall not disclose such information to any third party without the prior written consent of the disclosing party, except to employees, contractors, and advisors with a need to know and who are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than those set out herein. This obligation shall survive termination of this Agreement for a period of sixty (60) days and shall not apply to information that is or becomes publicly available through no fault of the receiving party. The receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to the extent required by law or a valid order of a court or governmental authority, provided that, to the extent legally permissible, it gives the disclosing party prompt written notice of such requirement so that the disclosing party may seek a protective order or other appropriate remedy at its own expense.

Neither party shall be liable for any failure or delay in the performance of its obligations under this Agreement, other than payment obligations, to the extent such failure or delay is caused by circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including acts of God, war, civil unrest, governmental action, pandemic, or failure of utilities or telecommunications infrastructure, provided that the affected party notifies the other party in writing within 5 days of the onset of such circumstances and uses commercially reasonable efforts to mitigate the impact. If such circumstances continue for more than ninety (90) days, either party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice. During the continuation of an event of force majeure, the unaffected party may, at its option and upon written notice, procure substitute goods or services from a third party to the extent reasonably necessary to mitigate the impact of the affected party's non-performance, without thereby waiving any right or remedy under this Agreement.

Any improvements, modifications, or derivative works created by Supplier in the course of manufacturing the industrial control modules that relate specifically to Buyer's proprietary designs shall be owned by Buyer, and Supplier hereby assigns all right, title, and interest in such improvements to Buyer. Supplier retains ownership of any general manufacturing know-how, tooling designs, and process improvements that are not specific to Buyer's proprietary designs and that Supplier would have developed irrespective of this Agreement, within thirty (30) days of first use. Where an improvement combines Buyer-specific design elements with Supplier's general manufacturing know-how in a manner that cannot reasonably be separated, the parties shall negotiate in good faith a reasonable allocation of rights, failing which Buyer shall be granted a perpetual, royalty-free license to use the improvement solely in connection with the industrial control modules.

Supplier shall comply with all applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards in the manufacture and supply of the custom wiring harnesses, including those relating to product safety, labor practices, and environmental protection in the State of New York. Supplier shall, upon Buyer's reasonable written request, provide documentation evidencing such compliance, and shall permit Buyer or its designated auditor to conduct an on-site compliance audit upon not less than 5 days' prior written notice, no more than once per forty-five (45) days period absent reasonable cause. Any audit conducted under this Clause shall be at Buyer's expense, shall be conducted during Supplier's normal business hours, and shall not unreasonably interfere with Supplier's manufacturing operations. Supplier shall address any material finding identified during an audit within 15 days of receiving Buyer's written audit report.

Supplier's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall be capped at 100% of the annual Contract Value; in no event shall Supplier be liable for consequential, incidental, or indirect damages of any kind arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, whether in contract, tort, or otherwise.

This Agreement shall terminate automatically, without notice, in the event either party becomes insolvent, makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors, or becomes subject to proceedings under applicable insolvency law that are not dismissed within 15 days. Upon termination for any reason, Buyer shall pay Supplier for all sealed bearing assemblies delivered and accepted prior to the effective date of termination, and each party shall, within ninety (90) days, return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party then in its possession. The provisions of this Agreement relating to confidentiality, intellectual property, and limitation of liability shall survive termination or expiration of this Agreement for any reason, together with any other provision that by its nature is intended to survive.

Supplier shall deliver the custom wiring harnesses to Buyer's designated receiving facility in accordance with the delivery schedule set out in Schedule 2, and time of delivery shall be of the essence. Should Supplier reasonably anticipate that a shipment will be delayed beyond the scheduled delivery date, Supplier shall notify Buyer in writing within 10 days of becoming aware of the anticipated delay, specifying the revised delivery date and the cause of the delay. Partial shipments shall be permitted only with Buyer's prior written consent, and each partial shipment shall be separately invoiced. Risk of loss shall pass to Buyer upon confirmed receipt at the designated facility, and Supplier shall retain risk of loss for all goods in transit prior to that point. Title to the goods shall pass to Buyer upon full payment of the applicable invoice, notwithstanding the earlier passage of risk of loss, and Supplier shall retain a purchase money security interest in the goods until such payment is received in full. Supplier shall maintain adequate insurance covering loss or damage to goods in transit and shall provide evidence of such coverage to Buyer upon reasonable written request.

A party affected by an event of force majeure shall promptly notify the other party of the nature and expected duration of the event, and shall be excused from performance, other than the obligation to make payments already due, for so long as the event of force majeure continues. Neither party shall be entitled to terminate this Agreement for force majeure to the extent the affected party's own failure to maintain reasonable business continuity arrangements contributed materially to its inability to perform, and the parties shall cooperate in good faith to identify reasonable workaround arrangements before either party exercises any right of termination under this Clause.
